user.description: Sign in with your NB Power MyAccount credentials (www.nbpower.com). The integration logs in for itself and renews sessions automatically.

reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again with your NB Power MyAccount credentials.

reconfigure.description: Enter the NB Power MyAccount username and password to use from now on. Entering the current ones again also signs in right away, without waiting for the next attempt.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to NB Power. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: NB Power turned the sign-in away.{reason} Check the username and password; if they work at www.nbpower.com, try again later.
error.sign_in_closed: NB Power is not taking sign-ins at the moment (it closes its login form for scheduled maintenance).{reason} Try again when it is back.
error.portal_error: NB Power's portal returned an unexpected response during sign-in. The Home Assistant log has the details (search for nbpower).
error.unknown: Unexpected error during sign-in. The Home Assistant log has the details (search for nbpower).

abort.already_configured: This NB Power account is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Signed in; the integration is using these credentials now.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different NB Power account than this entry.

data.backfill_hourly: Backfill last year at hourly resolution (otherwise only the last 10 days; background, resumable)
